summary: IceCure Medical Ltd. filed a Form 6-K covering its semi-annual report for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing discloses routine financial results, revenue concentrations, and several equity financings including private placements and an ATM program, but no special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, spin-off, or restructuring. The content is a standard foreign private issuer interim report with financial statements and operational updates. No board recommendation, advisors, or deal terms are mentioned. There is no risk-arb angle or strategic action to monitor; the filing reflects ordinary business and capital-raising activities.
